catalog.sar_inventory_scope: catalog declarations only; SAR files are not opened

policy.availability: numeric composite sampling under the declared source mask; no proof of valid mission observations or physical coverage
policy.comparison_arithmetic: integer micro-units of the stored six-decimal values
policy.coordinates: geographic degrees directly, or declared Titan_2000 spherical equirectangular metres; no datum transformation
policy.display_values: no sign or range threshold; finite zero and negative values allowed unless masked or declared nodata
policy.edges: no extrapolation outside the source pixel-center grid
policy.interpolation: bilinear at pixel centers; float32 source values; float64 arithmetic
policy.longitude: first in-bounds candidate among longitude modulo 360 and that value minus 360, after conversion to raster units
policy.producer_projection: PROJ from source geodetic_crs; always_xy=True; allow_ballpark=False; force_over=True
policy.projected_support: D_Titan_2000; EPSG method 1029; radius 2575000 m; zero standard parallel, origins and false offsets
policy.support: all positive-weight contributors in every channel finite and source-valid; honor both source masks and explicit nodata
policy.units: auxiliary display values; no calibrated spectral interpretation
